audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2..5].side are flat 'Skill' while content win[2..5] already say 'Xerath', and phases[6].side is 'Skill' while win[6] already says 'Milio'.
audit.why: win[] already tells a consistent behind-in-lane/ahead-late story (matches whys[] and spikes[]); side is the stale placeholder field.
audit.corrected: phases[2/3/4/5].side -> Xerath, phases[6].side -> Milio. Rows 0-1 already agree (Xerath).

audit.why: spikes[] already states a real curve: outranged from level 2, R execute-snipe threat at 6, item parity narrows the gap, 2+ items flips to Milio via grouped shields/cleanse.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions claims Milio's R (Breath of Life) cancels Xerath's channeled R outright, but Milio's R only heals/cleanses allies — it has no enemy-targeted CC (the 'hardCC' flag on ownerKit.R is a derived-flag misfire; Riot's own text says it only removes CC from allies). What actually interrupts a channel is displacement: Milio's Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) knocks the target back, and Xerath's R is flagged 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'. That correct version of the interaction was absent from the page.
audit.why: Shipping the brief's claim as-is would tell a reader to save R for his ult, which does nothing to it; the real counter is landing Q on him mid-channel.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d rewritten to state that a landed Q knockup cancels Rite of the Arcane.

edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: E has two charges — pre-shield your ADC before his Q/W poke lands, then save the second for his all-in window.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: His R immobilizes him for the whole channel — a landed Q knockup cancels Rite of the Arcane outright if your team can reach him.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. It writes your spacing rules. - R Breath of Life is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E, Stun): matchup-defining — 13s cooldown at rank 1, down to 11s at rank 5. Dodge it and the artillery never converts. - His R is a channel: a landed Q knockup interrupts it outright. - R Breath of Life is for saving fights, not seasoning trades.

notes: No pronoun issue (Xerath not on the female list). Rejected the brief's missingInteractions claim as literally written since it misattributes the interrupt to Milio's R; substituted the correct Q-knockup-cancels-channel version instead (see audit point 4).
